# `scikitplot.memmap`

<!-- Generated by `python tools/maint_tools/generate_usage_skills.py sync` from the installed package; edit the module's docstrings or `__all__`, not this file. -->

MemMap: file-backed or anonymous memory mapping.

## Install

```sh
pip install scikit-plots
```

## Example (from the docstring of `scikitplot.memmap.MemoryMap`)

```pycon
>>> with MemoryMap.create_anonymous(4096, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE) as m:
...     m.write(b"test")
...     data = m.read(4)
```
